  - No vomiting reported.
  - Constipation previously about a week ago; currently regular bowel movements, last bowel movement yesterday.
  - Drinking plenty of water; going to the toilet more frequently without urgency, dysuria, or foul urine odor reported.
  - Slight pink coloration in urine described by patient; uncertain relation to menses.
- Timeline
  - Abdominal ache and nausea began about 2–3 days ago; feverish symptoms for 2–3 days.
  - Constipation noted about a week ago and has since improved; last bowel movement yesterday.
  - Period history: last menstrual period about 3 weeks ago; due to start soon; patient unsure about pregnancy status.
- Exposures/initiating factors
  - Sexually active with one regular partner; uses Implanon (implant) for contraception.
- Associated symptoms/ROS
  - No vaginal discharge reported; no urinary pain or burning; no vomiting; no significant chest or systemic symptoms beyond described feverish/nausea.

  - Amoxicillin (allergic).

  - Implanon (implant) for contraception; dose/route/frequency not documented.
